subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails` true be suppressed globally, including cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and mutating paths, or should those detail-mode warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface exec details in several includeDetails modes, while this PR and its linked issue request suppressing exec-like warnings regardless of details; changing that behavior is a maintainer policy choice before code can be safely repaired.

options.title: Clarify And Rework
options.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning contract first, then move or narrow the suppression branch and update focused tests to match it.

options.title: Keep Detail-Mode Warnings
options.body: Reject the suppress-all policy and narrow the linked report to warning leaks where an assistant reply already makes the extra warning redundant.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Keep or close this PR as not merge-ready until the contributor or a maintainer supplies proof and a policy-aligned patch.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Rework
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning contract first, then move or narrow the suppression branch and update focused tests to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has helper-history commits and recent maintainer comments in the related exec-warning delivery cluster, making him the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
